title: Chapter 7: The Magic Mirror and the Return Home
chineseTitle: 第 7 章：魔法镜子与重返家园

paragraphs.en: Several months passed happily in the enchanted castle. Beauty spent her peaceful days reading rare romantic poetry, playing beautiful melodies on the harpsichord, and wandering through the fragrant glass greenhouses filled with rare tropical flowers. She lacked for nothing, and her fondness for the kind Beast grew deeper with each passing day as she realized his extraordinary goodness of heart.
paragraphs.zh: 几个月在魔法城堡里快乐地过去了。贝儿在安静的日子里阅读罕见的浪漫诗歌，在大键琴上弹奏美丽的旋律，漫步于开满罕见热带花卉的香气扑鼻的玻璃温室中。她什么也不缺，随着时间的流逝，当她意识到野兽非凡的心灵美德时，她对这位和蔼野兽的喜欢一天天加深。

paragraphs.en: Yet despite all her comforts, Beauty missed her beloved father dearly. One afternoon, looking into her magical mirror, she saw a heartbreaking scene: her poor father was lying bedridden in their small farm cottage, weeping bitterly and sick with grief over her unknown fate, while her sisters were preparing for luxurious parties.
paragraphs.zh: 然而尽管享受着所有的舒适，贝儿非常思念她亲爱的父亲。一天下午，看着她的魔法镜子，她看到了一幕令人心碎的场景：她可怜的父亲正因她未知的命运而悲伤号啕大哭、卧病在床，而她的姐姐们正在为奢华的聚会做准备。

paragraphs.en: Tears streamed down Beauty's face. That evening at dinner, when the Beast entered, he noticed her red eyes and asked with deep concern, 'What grieves you, dear Beauty?' Beauty threw herself at his feet, pleading with clasped hands: 'Oh, kind Beast! My poor father is dying of sorrow for me! If you love me, please allow me to return home to visit him for just seven days! I promise upon my sacred honor to return to you when the week is over!' The Beast consented with a heavy sigh, giving her a magic ring.
paragraphs.zh: 眼泪沿着贝儿的脸流下。那天晚上晚餐时，当野兽进来时，他注意到了她红红的双眼，怀着深深的关切问：“什么让你伤心，亲爱的贝儿？”贝儿扑倒在他的脚下，紧扣着双手恳求道：“哦，和蔼的野兽！我可怜的父亲正因思念我而悲伤得要死了！如果你爱我，请允许我回家看望他仅仅七天！我以我神圣的荣誉承诺在这一周结束后回到你身边！”野兽带着沉重的叹息同意了，给了她一只魔法戒指。
